document: DS8669 Rev 11 - Table 81. Document revision history
title: Table 81. Document revision history
text_helper: Table 81. Document revision history — section 9 Revision History. Date, Revision, Changes.

rows: Status of the document changed (datasheet instead of preliminary data). Added STM32L162RD part number. Added LQFP64 and WLCSP64 packages. Updated "Low power " and "Memory" feature on page 1. Introduction and Description: added 'high density'. GPIOF replaced with GIOPH. Added SDIO in Table 5: Ultralow power STM32L162xD device features and peripheral counts on page 13. Section 3: Functional overview: changed '128 kHz' to '131 kHz' in section "Low power run mode". Section 3.16: AES: updated '214' to '213' clock cycles. Section 3.17.1: General-purpose timers (TIM2, TIM3, TIM4, TIM5, TIM9, TIM10 and TIM11): changed 'six' to 'seven' synchronizable general-purpose timers. Added SDIO in Table 19: Alternate function input/output on page 86 (FSMC/SDIO instead of FSMC); modified alternate function for PA13 and PA14; removed EVENT OUT for PH2. Modified Section 3.4: Clock management on page 20. Table 15: STM32L162xD pin definitions on page 60: updated name of reference manual in footnote 4. Modified Figure 8: Power supply scheme on page 46. Modified Table 2: Functionalities depending on the operating power supply range on page 15. Table 18: Current consumption in Run mode, code with data processing running from RAM: added footnote 3. Table 19: Current consumption in Sleep mode: updated condition for f ; added footnote 3. HSE Table 23: Typical and maximum current consumptions in Standby mode: modified max values. Table 28: Peripheral current consumption: added AES. Table 64: USB DC electrical characteristics: removed two footnotes. Modified Table 38: Flash memory and data EEPROM characteristics on page 83. Modified tables in Section 6.3.4: Supply current characteristics on page 54.
